CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "Coach".refresh_learner_absence_counts(affected_learner_id integer, affected_learner_email text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    present_count integer := 0;
    absent_count integer := 0;
    normalized_email text := lower(trim(coalesce(affected_learner_email, '<literal redacted>')));
BEGIN
    IF affected_learner_id IS NULL AND normalized_email = '<literal redacted>' THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    SELECT
        count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE lower(trim(attendance_status::text)) IN
                ('<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>')
        ),
        count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE lower(trim(attendance_status::text)) IN
                ('<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>',
                 '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>')
        )
    INTO present_count, absent_count
    FROM "Learner".learner_attendance_details
    WHERE (
        affected_learner_id IS NOT NULL
        AND learner_id = affected_learner_id
    )
    OR (
        affected_learner_id IS NULL
        AND normalized_email <> '<literal redacted>'
        AND lower(trim(learner_email::text)) = normalized_email
    );

    UPDATE "Learner"."Absence"
    SET present = coalesce(present_count, 0),
        absent = coalesce(absent_count, 0),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE (
        affected_learner_id IS NOT NULL
        AND learner_id = affected_learner_id
    )
    OR (
        affected_learner_id IS NULL
        AND normalized_email <> '<literal redacted>'
        AND lower(trim(learner_email::text)) = normalized_email
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "Learner".guard_unique_learner_lms_activity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            new_material_ids bigint[];
        BEGIN
            IF NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
               OR NEW.activity_id IS NULL
               OR NEW.category NOT IN ('<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>') THEN
                RETURN NEW;
            END IF;
            IF TG_OP = '<literal redacted>'
               AND OLD.aptem_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.aptem_id
               AND OLD.activity_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.activity_id
               AND OLD.source_ref IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_ref
               AND OLD.category IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.category
               AND OLD.deleted_at IS NULL THEN
                RETURN NEW;
            END IF;

            new_material_ids :=
                "Learner"."lms_material_activity_ids"(
                    NEW.source_ref, NEW.activity_id
                );
            -- Lock each material separately and in stable order. A bundle
            -- (55,56) and a standalone row (56) must serialize on the same
            -- key even though their complete material arrays differ.
            PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
                hashtext('<literal redacted>'),
                hashtext(NEW.aptem_id::text || '<literal redacted>' || material_id::text)
            )
            FROM unnest(new_material_ids) AS material_id
            ORDER BY material_id;
            IF EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM "Learner"."learner_journal_rows" existing
                WHERE existing.aptem_id = NEW.aptem_id
                  AND existing.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND existing.activity_id IS NOT NULL
                  AND existing.category IN ('<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>')
                  AND existing.id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id
                  AND "Learner"."lms_material_activity_ids"(
                        existing.source_ref, existing.activity_id
                      ) && new_material_ids
            ) THEN
                RAISE unique_violation
                    USING CONSTRAINT = '<literal redacted>',
                          MESSAGE = '<literal redacted>';
            END IF;
            RETURN NEW;
        END
        $function$

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    linked_learner_id bigint;
    linked_progress_id bigint;
BEGIN
    SELECT journal.canonical_learner_id, journal.progress_id
    INTO linked_learner_id, linked_progress_id
    FROM "Learner".learner_journal_rows journal
    WHERE journal.id = NEW.manual_activity_id;
    IF linked_learner_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO "Learner".learner_activity_documents (
        learner_id, progress_id, source_system, source_document_id,
        container, blob_name, display_name, content_type, size_bytes,
        uploaded_by, uploaded_at, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at

        linked_learner_id, linked_progress_id, '<literal redacted>',
        '<literal redacted>' || NEW.id::text,
        NEW.container, NEW.blob_name, NEW.display_name,
        coalesce(NEW.content_type, '<literal redacted>'), NEW.size_bytes,
        coalesce(NEW.uploaded_by, '<literal redacted>'), NEW.uploaded_at, NEW.deleted_at,
        coalesce(NEW.uploaded_at, now()), now()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (source_system, source_document_id) DO UPDATE SET
        learner_id = excluded.learner_id,
        progress_id = excluded.progress_id,
        container = excluded.container,
        blob_name = excluded.blob_name,

        content_type = excluded.content_type,
        size_bytes = excluded.size_bytes,
        uploaded_by = excluded.uploaded_by,
        uploaded_at = excluded.uploaded_at,
        deleted_at = excluded.deleted_at,
        updated_at = now();
    RETURN NEW;
END

name: sync_journal_row_to_activity_ssot
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "Learner".sync_journal_row_to_activity_ssot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    linked_learner_id bigint;
    linked_source_id bigint;
    linked_progress_id bigint;
    next_entry_order integer;
    catalog_activity_id bigint;
    catalog_component_ref text;
    catalogue_course_ref text;
    catalogue_module_ref text;
    catalogue_module_title text;
    journal_kind text;
    journal_seconds bigint;
    journal_status text;
    journal_completed boolean;
    created_progress boolean := false;
    actual_changed boolean := true;
BEGIN
    linked_learner_id := NEW.canonical_learner_id;
    IF linked_learner_id IS NULL THEN
        SELECT learner.id INTO linked_learner_id
        FROM "Learner".learners learner
        WHERE learner.aptem_id = NEW.aptem_id
        LIMIT 1;
        NEW.canonical_learner_id := linked_learner_id;
    END IF;
    IF linked_learner_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;

    -- A migration insert already carries the canonical links and must not
    -- rewrite AI-generated timestamps or second-level duration evidence.
    IF TG_OP = '<literal redacted>' AND NEW.progress_id IS NOT NULL
       AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    IF TG_OP = '<literal redacted>' THEN
        actual_changed := OLD.actual_hours IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.actual_hours;
    END IF;

    journal_kind := CASE WHEN NEW.category = '<literal redacted>'
                         THEN '<literal redacted>'
                         ELSE NEW.category END;
    journal_seconds := round(NEW.actual_hours * 3600)::bigint;
    journal_status := coalesce(nullif(NEW.completion_note, '<literal redacted>'),
                               CASE WHEN NEW.accepted
                                    THEN '<literal redacted>' ELSE '<literal redacted>' END);
    journal_completed := lower(journal_status) NOT IN (
        '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>'
    );

    SELECT activity.id, activity.curriculum_component_ref,
           course.source_course_ref, course.curriculum_module_ref,
           module.title
    INTO catalog_activity_id, catalog_component_ref,
         catalogue_course_ref, catalogue_module_ref,
         catalogue_module_title
    FROM curriculum.source_courses course
    JOIN curriculum.source_activities activity
      ON activity.source_course_id = course.id
     AND activity.source_activity_id = NEW.activity_id::text
     AND activity.deleted_at IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN curriculum.modules module
      ON module.module_catalogue_id = course.curriculum_module_ref
    WHERE course.source_system = '<literal redacted>'
      AND course.source_course_ref = NEW.group_id::text
      AND course.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY activity.id
    LIMIT 1;

    linked_progress_id := NEW.progress_id;
    IF linked_progress_id IS NULL THEN
        SELECT source.canonical_progress_id, source.id
        INTO linked_progress_id, linked_source_id
        FROM "Learner".learner_activity_sources source
        WHERE source.learner_id = linked_learner_id
          AND source.source_system = '<literal redacted>'
          AND source.source_activity_id = '<literal redacted>' || NEW.id::text
        ORDER BY (source.deleted_at IS NULL) DESC, source.id
        LIMIT 1;
        NEW.source_id := coalesce(NEW.source_id, linked_source_id);
    END IF;
    IF linked_progress_id IS NULL THEN
        PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
            hashtext('<literal redacted>'), linked_learner_id::integer
        );
        SELECT coalesce(max(entry_order), 0) + 1
        INTO next_entry_order
        FROM "Learner".learner_progress_entries
        WHERE learner_id = linked_learner_id;
        INSERT INTO "Learner".learner_progress_entries (
            learner_id, entry_order, kind,
            module_ref, module_title,
            component_ref, component_title, component_type,
            feed_kind, feed_action, feed_title, feed_detail,
            feed_occurred_at, enrolment_id, programme_id, aptem_id,
            curriculum_component_ref, source_system,
            source_activity_id, canonical_activity_key,
            activity_status, accepted, actual_seconds, actual_basis,
            reporting_month, reporting_timestamp_label,
            source_payload, deleted_at
        )
        SELECT linked_learner_id, next_entry_order, journal_kind,
               catalogue_module_ref, coalesce(catalogue_module_title, '<literal redacted>'),
               coalesce(catalog_component_ref, '<literal redacted>' || NEW.id::text),
               NEW.title, journal_kind,
               journal_kind, '<literal redacted>', NEW.title,
               coalesce(NEW.completion_note, '<literal redacted>'), NEW.updated_at,
               learner.enrolment_id,
               coalesce(nullif(NEW.programme_profile_id, '<literal redacted>'),
                        learner.programme_id),
               NEW.aptem_id, catalog_component_ref,
               '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>' || NEW.id::text,
               '<literal redacted>' || NEW.id::text,
               journal_status, NEW.accepted, journal_seconds,
               CASE WHEN NEW.accepted
                    THEN '<literal redacted>'
                    ELSE '<literal redacted>' END,
               NEW.month, NEW.timestamp_label,
               jsonb_build_object(
                   '<literal redacted>', NEW.id,
                   '<literal redacted>', NEW.source_ref,
                   '<literal redacted>', NEW.planned_hours::text
               ), NEW.deleted_at
        FROM "Learner".learners learner
        WHERE learner.id = linked_learner_id
        RETURNING id INTO linked_progress_id;
        NEW.progress_id := linked_progress_id;
        created_progress := true;
    ELSE
        NEW.progress_id := linked_progress_id;
    END IF;

    linked_source_id := NEW.source_id;
    IF linked_source_id IS NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO "Learner".learner_activity_sources (
            learner_id, enrolment_id, programme_id, aptem_id,
            source_system, source_activity_id, canonical_activity_key,
            activity_type, title, activity_status, completed, accepted,
            actual_seconds, actual_basis, reporting_month,
            source_payload, source_updated_at, canonical_progress_id,
            source_course_ref, source_catalog_activity_id, deleted_at
        )
        SELECT linked_learner_id, learner.enrolment_id,
               coalesce(nullif(NEW.programme_profile_id, '<literal redacted>'),
                        learner.programme_id),
               NEW.aptem_id, '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>' || NEW.id::text,
               '<literal redacted>' || NEW.id::text,
               NEW.category, NEW.title, journal_status,
               journal_completed, NEW.accepted, journal_seconds,
               CASE WHEN NEW.accepted
                    THEN '<literal redacted>'
                    ELSE '<literal redacted>' END,
               NEW.month,
               jsonb_build_object(
                   '<literal redacted>', NEW.id,
                   '<literal redacted>', NEW.source_ref,
                   '<literal redacted>', NEW.planned_hours::text
               ), NEW.updated_at, linked_progress_id,
               coalesce(catalogue_course_ref, NEW.group_id::text, '<literal redacted>'),
               catalog_activity_id, NEW.deleted_at
        FROM "Learner".learners learner
        WHERE learner.id = linked_learner_id
        RETURNING id INTO linked_source_id;
        NEW.source_id := linked_source_id;
    END IF;

    IF NOT created_progress THEN
        UPDATE "Learner".learner_progress_entries progress
        SET component_title = NEW.title,
            feed_title = NEW.title,
            feed_detail = coalesce(NEW.completion_note, '<literal redacted>'),
            activity_status = journal_status,
            accepted = NEW.accepted,
            actual_seconds = CASE WHEN actual_changed
                THEN journal_seconds ELSE progress.actual_seconds END,
            actual_basis = CASE
                WHEN actual_changed
                THEN CASE WHEN NEW.accepted
                          THEN '<literal redacted>'
                          ELSE '<literal redacted>' END
                ELSE progress.actual_basis END,
            reporting_month = NEW.month,
            reporting_timestamp_label = NEW.timestamp_label,
            source_payload = progress.source_payload || jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal redacted>', NEW.id,
                '<literal redacted>', NEW.source_ref,
                '<literal redacted>', NEW.planned_hours::text
            ),
            deleted_at = NEW.deleted_at,
            ssot_updated_at = now()
        WHERE progress.id = linked_progress_id;
    END IF;

    UPDATE "Learner".learner_activity_sources source
    SET title = NEW.title,
        activity_status = journal_status,
        completed = journal_completed,
        accepted = NEW.accepted,
        actual_seconds = CASE WHEN actual_changed
            THEN journal_seconds ELSE source.actual_seconds END,
        actual_basis = CASE
            WHEN actual_changed
            THEN CASE WHEN NEW.accepted
                      THEN '<literal redacted>'
                      ELSE '<literal redacted>' END
            ELSE source.actual_basis END,
        reporting_month = NEW.month,
        source_payload = source.source_payload || jsonb_build_object(
            '<literal redacted>', NEW.id,
            '<literal redacted>', NEW.source_ref,
            '<literal redacted>', NEW.planned_hours::text
        ),
        source_updated_at = NEW.updated_at,
        canonical_progress_id = linked_progress_id,
        source_course_ref = coalesce(
            nullif(catalogue_course_ref, '<literal redacted>'), NEW.group_id::text,
            source.source_course_ref
        ),
        source_catalog_activity_id = coalesce(
            catalog_activity_id, source.source_catalog_activity_id
        ),
        curriculum_component_ref = coalesce(
            catalog_component_ref, source.curriculum_component_ref
        ),
        deleted_at = NEW.deleted_at,
        last_seen_at = now()
    WHERE source.id = linked_source_id;

    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "Learner".target_hours_as_of(p_planned_hours numeric, p_start_date date, p_planned_end_date date, p_as_of_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN p_planned_hours IS NULL OR p_planned_hours <= 0
          OR p_start_date IS NULL OR p_planned_end_date IS NULL
          OR p_planned_end_date <= p_start_date
            THEN NULL::numeric
        WHEN p_as_of_date < p_start_date
            THEN 0.00::numeric
        WHEN p_as_of_date >= p_planned_end_date
            THEN round(p_planned_hours, 2)
        ELSE round(
            least(
                p_planned_hours,
                greatest(
                    0.00::numeric,
                    (p_planned_hours * (p_as_of_date - p_start_date)::numeric)
                    / (p_planned_end_date - p_start_date)::numeric
                )
            ),
            2
        )
    END
$function$

 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$

        WHEN NULLIF(btrim(value), '<literal redacted>') IS NULL THEN NULL::date
        WHEN btrim(value) ~ '<literal redacted>'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_kbc_combined_attendance()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_stale integer := 0;
  v_changed integer := 0;
  v_source integer := 0;
BEGIN
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('<literal redacted>'));

  CREATE TEMP TABLE pg_temp.kbc_combined_snapshot ON COMMIT DROP AS
    SELECT * FROM kbc_sync.combined_attendance_source;
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON pg_temp.kbc_combined_snapshot (learner_email, session_date, module_key);

  SELECT count(*) INTO v_source FROM pg_temp.kbc_combined_snapshot;

  UPDATE public.kbc_combined_attendance c
     SET is_current = false, updated_at = clock_timestamp()
   WHERE c.is_current
     AND NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM pg_temp.kbc_combined_snapshot s
       WHERE s.learner_email = c.learner_email
         AND s.session_date = c.session_date
         AND s.module_key = c.module_key
     );
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_stale = ROW_COUNT;

  INSERT INTO public.kbc_combined_attendance AS c
    (learner_email, session_date, module_key, module_name, learner_name,
     legacy_records, lms_records, aptem_ids, lms_profile_ids, lms_occurrence_ids,
     learner_emails, legacy_record_count, lms_record_count,
     attendance_result, identity_conflict, is_current)
  SELECT learner_email, session_date, module_key, module_name, learner_name,
         legacy_records, lms_records, aptem_ids, lms_profile_ids, lms_occurrence_ids,
         learner_emails, legacy_record_count, lms_record_count,
         attendance_result, identity_conflict, true
    FROM pg_temp.kbc_combined_snapshot
  ON CONFLICT (learner_email, session_date, module_key)
  DO UPDATE SET
    module_name = EXCLUDED.module_name,
    learner_name = EXCLUDED.learner_name,
    legacy_records = EXCLUDED.legacy_records,
    lms_records = EXCLUDED.lms_records,
    aptem_ids = EXCLUDED.aptem_ids,
    lms_profile_ids = EXCLUDED.lms_profile_ids,
    lms_occurrence_ids = EXCLUDED.lms_occurrence_ids,
    learner_emails = EXCLUDED.learner_emails,
    legacy_record_count = EXCLUDED.legacy_record_count,
    lms_record_count = EXCLUDED.lms_record_count,
    attendance_result = EXCLUDED.attendance_result,
    identity_conflict = EXCLUDED.identity_conflict,
    is_current = true,
    updated_at = clock_timestamp()
  WHERE NOT c.is_current
     OR (c.module_name, c.learner_name, c.legacy_records, c.lms_records,
         c.aptem_ids, c.lms_profile_ids, c.lms_occurrence_ids, c.learner_emails,
         c.legacy_record_count, c.lms_record_count, c.attendance_result, c.identity_conflict)
        IS DISTINCT FROM
        (EXCLUDED.module_name, EXCLUDED.learner_name, EXCLUDED.legacy_records, EXCLUDED.lms_records,
         EXCLUDED.aptem_ids, EXCLUDED.lms_profile_ids, EXCLUDED.lms_occurrence_ids, EXCLUDED.learner_emails,
         EXCLUDED.legacy_record_count, EXCLUDED.lms_record_count, EXCLUDED.attendance_result, EXCLUDED.identity_conflict);
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_changed = ROW_COUNT;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('<literal redacted>', v_source, '<literal redacted>', v_changed,
                            '<literal redacted>', v_stale, '<literal redacted>', clock_timestamp());
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.show_db_tree()
 RETURNS TABLE(tree_structure text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- First show all databases
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT '<literal redacted>' || datname || '<literal redacted>'
    FROM pg_database
    WHERE datistemplate = false;

    -- Then show current database structure
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH RECURSIVE
    -- Get schemas
    schemas AS (
        SELECT
            n.nspname AS object_name,
            1 AS level,
            n.nspname AS path,
            '<literal redacted>' AS object_type
        FROM pg_namespace n
        WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE '<literal redacted>'
        AND n.nspname != '<literal redacted>'
    ),

    -- Get all objects (tables, views, functions, etc.)
    objects AS (
        SELECT
            c.relname AS object_name,
            2 AS level,
            s.path || '<literal redacted>' || c.relname AS path,
            CASE c.relkind
                WHEN '<literal redacted>' THEN '<literal redacted>'
                WHEN '<literal redacted>' THEN '<literal redacted>'
                WHEN '<literal redacted>' THEN '<literal redacted>'
                WHEN '<literal redacted>' THEN '<literal redacted>'
                WHEN '<literal redacted>' THEN '<literal redacted>'
                WHEN '<literal redacted>' THEN '<literal redacted>'
            END AS object_type
        FROM pg_class c
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
        JOIN schemas s ON n.nspname = s.object_name
        WHERE c.relkind IN ('<literal redacted>','<literal redacted>','<literal redacted>','<literal redacted>','<literal redacted>','<literal redacted>')

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            p.proname AS object_name,
            2 AS level,
            s.path || '<literal redacted>' || p.proname AS path,
            '<literal redacted>' AS object_type
        FROM pg_proc p
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
        JOIN schemas s ON n.nspname = s.object_name
    ),

    -- Combine schemas and objects
    combined AS (
        SELECT * FROM schemas
        UNION ALL
        SELECT * FROM objects
    )

    -- Final output with tree-like formatting
    SELECT
        REPEAT('<literal redacted>', level) ||
        CASE
            WHEN level = 1 THEN '<literal redacted>'
            ELSE '<literal redacted>' ||
                CASE object_type
                    WHEN '<literal redacted>' THEN '<literal redacted>'
                    WHEN '<literal redacted>' THEN '<literal redacted>'
                    WHEN '<literal redacted>' THEN '<literal redacted>'
                    WHEN '<literal redacted>' THEN '<literal redacted>'
                    WHEN '<literal redacted>' THEN '<literal redacted>'
                    WHEN '<literal redacted>' THEN '<literal redacted>'
                    WHEN '<literal redacted>' THEN '<literal redacted>'
                    ELSE '<literal redacted>'
                END
        END || object_name || '<literal redacted>' || object_type || '<literal redacted>'
    FROM combined
    ORDER BY path;
END;

guard_unique_learner_lms_activity
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION structured_manual_activities.guard_unique_learner_lms_activity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            new_material_ids bigint[];
        BEGIN
            IF NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
               OR NEW.activity_id IS NULL
               OR NEW.category NOT IN ('<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>') THEN
                RETURN NEW;
            END IF;
            IF TG_OP = '<literal redacted>'
               AND OLD.aptem_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.aptem_id
               AND OLD.activity_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.activity_id
               AND OLD.source_ref IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_ref
               AND OLD.category IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.category
               AND OLD.deleted_at IS NULL THEN
                RETURN NEW;
            END IF;

            new_material_ids :=
                "structured_manual_activities"."lms_material_activity_ids"(
                    NEW.source_ref, NEW.activity_id
                );
            -- Lock each material separately and in stable order. A bundle
            -- (55,56) and a standalone row (56) must serialize on the same
            -- key even though their complete material arrays differ.
            PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
                hashtext('<literal redacted>'),
                hashtext(NEW.aptem_id::text || '<literal redacted>' || material_id::text)
            )
            FROM unnest(new_material_ids) AS material_id
            ORDER BY material_id;
            IF EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM "structured_manual_activities"."manual_learner_activities" existing
                WHERE existing.aptem_id = NEW.aptem_id
                  AND existing.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND existing.activity_id IS NOT NULL
                  AND existing.category IN ('<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>')
                  AND existing.id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id
                  AND "structured_manual_activities"."lms_material_activity_ids"(
                        existing.source_ref, existing.activity_id
                      ) && new_material_ids
            ) THEN
                RAISE unique_violation
                    USING CONSTRAINT = '<literal redacted>',
                          MESSAGE = '<literal redacted>';
            END IF;
            RETURN NEW;
        END
        $function$

name: lms_material_activity_ids
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION structured_manual_activities.lms_material_activity_ids(source_ref text, activity_id bigint)
 RETURNS bigint[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
            SELECT CASE
                WHEN source_ref ~ '<literal redacted>'
                THEN string_to_array(
                    regexp_replace(source_ref, '<literal redacted>', '<literal redacted>'), '<literal redacted>'
                )::bigint[]
                WHEN activity_id IS NOT NULL THEN ARRAY[activity_id]
                ELSE ARRAY[]::bigint[]
            END
        $function$
